by: mcp-1 session (Opus), ruling 96; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One record of the query-nz ingest MCP's beehive corpus, as support/mcpsource lands it (JSON, keys sorted, no spaces, without seq)

landmarks: a JSON object with `id` and `url` (the same address on every record seen), `url` under https://www.beehive.govt.nz/
`ministers` [{name, slug}], `portfolios` [text], `topics` [text] and `quotes` [{text, speaker}], the last two made by the provider's model

signals_note: Landed by support/mcpsource from the MCP's records tool; the document's name `beehive/<id>` and its arrival row in mcpsource.arrivals say which corpus it is. Nothing is fetched from beehive.govt.nz (ruling 78).
notes: No model reads it: the fields are taken as served (ruling 79 untouched). Topics and quotes are the source's annotation, kept marked model-made and never a claim or a link (ruling 96). A field this profile does not name is listed in releases.fields_unread and support/mcpsource's drift table.
